title: Orbyss Program Kit self-hosted baseline
intent: Describe the implemented Program Kit packages, dependency direction, governance boundaries, and deterministic projections using the architecture-design contract that the Kit itself supplies.
scope: The independently packageable Program Kit source projects under program-kit/src.
The dependency and forbidden-reference boundaries enforced by the Program Kit conformance suite.
The self-hosted design, plan, Markdown, graph, comparison, relationship, and receipt artifacts produced by PK-W080.
nonGoals: This design does not rewrite, replace, or retroactively attribute the bootstrap design and plan.
This design does not add release, publication, deployment, durable tasking, or Domain Semantic Engine behavior.
assumptions: The repository source and the approved bootstrap review set remain authoritative when a projection differs.
Every Program Kit project targets the repository-pinned .NET 10 toolchain and package version 0.1.0-alpha.1.

referenceRules.referencingScope: Program Kit projects may reference only the exact inward project edges declared by their project files and this design.
referenceRules.referencedScope: Universal contracts, focused helpers, explicitly selected providers, and host bridges.
referenceRules.rationale: Explicit inward edges keep universal contracts independent of hosts, providers, and development-session behavior.

referenceRules.referencedScope: .agents capabilities, .codex skill wrappers, and capability session procedures
referenceRules.rationale: Runtime code remains isolated from development-session capabilities; only the content-only bundle packages reviewed files.

artifactDecisions.requestedOutcome: Represent the implemented Program Kit baseline as a validated architecture-design contract instance.

executableBehavior.rationale: The design carries architecture meaning and no executable behavior.

valueLifecycle.rationale: The design is schema-validated, compared with its bootstrap source, and digest-bound by dependent artifacts.

agentRetrieval.rationale: The canonical instance is a repository artifact, not an agent retrieval procedure.

agentProcedure.rationale: The instance does not grant or contain an agent procedure.

humanCommunication.rationale: Human communication is supplied by a separate deterministic Markdown projection.

generatedNavigation.rationale: Navigation is supplied by separate declared projection artifacts.

governance.provenancePolicy: The approved bootstrap design and current repository source are named as source truth; no retroactive capability authorship is claimed.
governance.digestPolicy: Downstream plan, comparison, relationship, projection, and receipt artifacts bind the exact committed source bytes.
governance.compatibilityPolicy: A breaking semantic or wire change requires a new design version and an explicit comparison.
governance.migrationPolicy: Create a new exact self-hosted instance; never rewrite the historical bootstrap inputs.

dataHandling.redactionPolicy: No secrets or personal content are included.
dataHandling.externalizationPolicy: The committed repository artifact is the only intended externalization.
dataHandling.ephemeralDataPolicy: Session-only values are kept out of the canonical design.

artifactDecisions.rationale: A schema-governed design instance is the canonical self-hosted architecture source.

artifactDecisions.requestedOutcome: Provide a stable human-readable projection of the canonical self-hosted design.

valueLifecycle.rationale: The projection is byte-compared and digest-bound.

agentRetrieval.rationale: The projection is a repository file.

agentProcedure.rationale: The projection contains no capability procedure.

humanCommunication.decisionAuthorityBoundary: The projection reports architecture and never grants approval.
humanCommunication.rationale: Markdown is the deliberate human-readable representation.

generatedNavigation.generationRule: Order sections and identifiers ordinally from the canonical design.
generatedNavigation.rationale: Stable navigation makes the canonical design reviewable.

representation.projectionRule: Render title, intent, scope, project/package inventory, boundaries, scenarios, and status in stable ordinal order.
representation.lossPolicy: The projection is intentionally lossy; the JSON design remains authoritative.

governance.provenancePolicy: The exact canonical design bytes are the sole projection input.
governance.digestPolicy: The comparison test fixes the exact Markdown byte digest.
governance.compatibilityPolicy: Regenerate whenever the canonical design changes.
governance.migrationPolicy: Regenerate rather than transform the projection.

dataHandling.redactionPolicy: No sensitive data is accepted from the canonical design.
dataHandling.externalizationPolicy: The committed Markdown file is the only intended externalization.
dataHandling.ephemeralDataPolicy: No timestamps or environment-local values are rendered.

artifactDecisions.rationale: The deterministic Markdown file is a disposable projection of the canonical JSON design.

representationRelationships.projectionRule: Render stable reviewer-oriented sections from the canonical design.
representationRelationships.lossPolicy: Detailed contract fields remain available only in the canonical JSON.

security.policy: Program Kit never infers security authority from artifact presence.
guarantees: Security-sensitive behavior requires explicit reviewed contracts and configuration.
exclusions: No implicit trust, secret discovery, or authorization grant.

authority.policy: Only explicit human evidence grants design or implementation authority.
guarantees: Tools and capabilities report or execute only within a human-started boundary.
exclusions: No tool-generated approval and no receipt-generated authority.

secrets.policy: Canonical Program Kit artifacts contain no secrets.
guarantees: Configuration contracts separate secret references from persisted public values.
exclusions: No ambient secret lookup or secret material in self-hosted artifacts.

persistence.policy: Persistence is explicit per artifact or provider.
guarantees: Canonical repository artifacts are exact files; task defaults are process-local and volatile.
exclusions: No durable or distributed tasking claim.

failure.policy: Invalid, ambiguous, incomplete, or out-of-scope inputs fail closed with stable diagnostics.
guarantees: Declared outputs are not partially published on failure.
exclusions: No silent fallback that changes semantic intent.

concurrency.policy: Concurrent behavior is bounded and explicitly selected.
guarantees: In-process task concurrency and retention have configured maxima.
exclusions: No cross-process lease or coordination semantics.

cancellation.policy: Operations and task attempts declare cancellation boundaries and commit races.
guarantees: Cancellation is propagated without reclassifying committed completion.
exclusions: No cancellation claim outside a declared operation or attempt.

observability.policy: Diagnostics, correlations, activities, and receipts report evidence without granting authority.
guarantees: Stable identifiers and exact digests make observations reproducible.
exclusions: No ambient telemetry endpoint or implicit health publication.

compatibility.policy: Every persisted, generated, consumed, or published boundary carries explicit version and compatibility meaning.
guarantees: Breaking changes require a new exact revision and migration disposition.
exclusions: No floating package, schema, capability, or generated-output selection.

scenarios.intent: Review the implemented Program Kit through its own contracts without losing bootstrap history.
preconditions: The exact bootstrap design, plan, review manifest, and approval record are intact.
The implement-software-plan capability is registered at its actual digest.
steps: Validate the self-hosted design and separate plan against their exact schemas.
Review deterministic Markdown and dependency, forbidden-reference, and Version Map graphs.
Review the structured bootstrap comparison and approval relationship report.
Verify the post-registration development receipt against the registered capability bytes.
outcomes: The self-hosted artifacts are reviewable and digest-bound.
Historical bootstrap authority remains explicit and unchanged.
failureOutcomes: A schema, digest, graph, projection, capability, or bootstrap-integrity mismatch fails conformance.

statusClaims.claim: PK-W080 supplies the canonical self-hosted design instance and comparison evidence without replacing its historical source.
